api-endpoint.tooltip: The full URL of your Tasmota engergy meter status endpoint e.g. http://192.168.1.1/cm?cmnd=Status%208

refresh-interval.tooltip: How often to fetch data from the Tasmota device

json-key.tooltip: The path to the root object containing energy data (e.g., StatusSNS for Tasmota devices)

use-eu-format.description: Use European number format (1.234,56 instead of 1,234.56)

datetime-format.tooltip: Format string for the timestamp (e.g., %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S for full date and time)
